about: A narration's chunks: the pieces it is recorded, retaken and timed in. Its sentences, for the cases with `sentences`.

chunks.why: with no line break, a chunk is a sentence
chunks.narration: Open the changes. Leave notes in ink! Want a tour? Yes.

chunks.why: a line break ends a chunk, which can hold several sentences
chunks.narration:
Open the changes. Read them properly.
Leave notes in ink.

See a diagram. Then ship.
chunks: Open the changes. Read them properly.

chunks.why: a Windows line break is a line break
audio tags are not part of a chunk, and a line of nothing but tags is not a chunk
chunks.narration:
[enthusiasm] Red Pen is local, [natural pace] fast and private.
[pause]
[bold] Review faster.
chunks: Red Pen is local, fast and private.

chunks.why: one line with a trailing break is still split by sentence
nothing but a tag has no chunks

sentences.why: a full stop inside a word does not end a sentence
a run of marks ends a sentence once, at the last
